script_text: The ancient bond between humans and spirit animals is more than myth—it's a cosmic blueprint that awaits your eyes. Spirit Animals is an air sign ruled by Mercury, embodying the raw essence of the wild and pulling you into a conversation with the unseen guardians. You will feel a sudden, magnetic pull toward the forest as your intuition sharpens. Love: Venus in the 7th House squares Mercury, creating a passionate but fleeting connection that calls you deeper. Career: The Sun in the 10th House trines Jupiter, bringing creative abundance and leadership. Shadow: retrograde motion through the 7th House where old love patterns come to light. Chiron's whisper in the 10th House warns of a karmic lesson about unspoken fears in your career. Stay grounded in the 1st House; don't chase every fleeting spirit animal encounter that comes your way. Trust the whispers of the wild and call for your spirit animal now today.
